title: Real-model variable, transfer and transaction authority binding

dependency_gate.implementation_rule: No real-model substitution experiment before DUMMY-17 closes. Authority/document mapping may be prepared prospectively.

purpose: Bind every analytical state, transfer, decision and commit object to a pinned real-model observable or explicitly mark it non-equivalent before any component is substituted.

required_bindings.real: physical UserDemand inflow/link flow and aligned supplied result

known_non_equivalences: dummy hard active-set hmin is not identical to current smooth UserDemand physical reduction
linear constant-area Basin is not arbitrary Ribasim area-level-storage relation
dummy one-Basin priority split is not full JuMP/network allocation

required_bindings.real: package conductance/effective interface parameter only after package mapping is pinned

unresolved_authorities: mapping from dummy A_g to actual MODFLOW storage response

required_bindings.real: production SWAP state/aggregate that physically owns irrigation memory
production irrigation-demand derivation and scheduling state
production realized-irrigation application to accepted SWAP state

required_bindings.analytical: root external loss E / rain P
required_bindings.real: pinned precipitation, ET/root uptake and other owned flux terms
only after production drainage ownership is resolved

swap.current_blocker: Current central architecture/control documents do not yet bind an explicit production irrigation-demand owner/timing contract.

pass_rules: Every analytical quantity used in a substitution experiment has exactly one pinned real authority or is explicitly declared non-equivalent.
Every accepted physical transfer has one integrated volume and opposite component-ledger signs where both endpoints lie inside the represented system.
No real-model diagnostic is silently promoted to state authority.
No allocated management amount is treated as supplied physical water without physical evidence.
Time alignment is explicit for every compared quantity.
Real-model output lag, averaging or integration semantics are recorded before numerical comparison.
Storage and drainage ownership blockers remain open unless separately closed by their owning workstreams.
planned_substitution_order: real Ribasim physical/allocation layer with analytical groundwater/root
controlled real MODFLOW replacing analytical groundwater while root remains analytical
real Ribasim + real MODFLOW + analytical root proxy
production SWAP irrigation/root state replacing analytical root only after SWAP demand authority binding
forbidden: no component substitution before its authority row is pinned
no calibration of analytical parameters to hide semantic non-equivalence
no production claim from dummy agreement alone
no closing CSR-B1/CSR-B2 from DUMMY-18 mapping work
